info.name: TaxJar Sales Tax Categories Transactions - Refunds API
info.description:
REST API for real-time sales tax calculation, rooftop-level rate lookups, tax category listing, transaction management (orders and refunds), customer exemption management, nexus region tracking, address validation, and VAT validation. Supports token-based authentication via Authorization header. TaxJar is a Stripe company providing sub-20ms response times and 99.999% historical uptime.

Contact Support:
 Name: TaxJar Developer Support
